title: DataScience TelemetryExportMergeReport

stats.done_summary:
Completed the Q1 2024 Generator Telemetry Export Merge Report. All deliverables are in place:

**Analysis (code/analysis.py):**
- Loaded and inspected both telemetry exports (site historian: 30 rows; field ops: 32 rows)
- Cleaned and normalized data: standardized unit names (T01→T-01), parsed heterogeneous date formats, applied 3-sigma outlier filter
- Detected and quarantined 2 anomalous field export records: row 31 (missing date, sentinel value 9,999 kWh) and row 32 (invalid date 13/37/2024)
- Performed full outer merge on (date, unit) composite key — all 30 valid records matched perfectly (100% agreement, Δ=0, r=1.000)
- Computed unit-level and fleet-level statistics; saved 5 output CSVs/JSON

**Figures (report/images/, 7 PNG files):**
- Fig 1: Daily kWh per unit time series
- Fig 2: Daily total comparison (site vs field overlay)
- Fig 3: Per-record scatter plot (site vs field, 1:1 line)
- Fig 4: Delta over time (all zeros confirmed)
- Fig 5: Stacked bar chart by unit
- Fig 6: Box plot distribution per unit
- Fig 7: Anomaly detection visualization with detail table

**Report (report/report.md):**
- Executive summary, introduction, methodology, full results tables, discussion, and 8 actionable recommendations
- Key findings: 1,935 kWh total fleet output; T-03 leads at 655 kWh; perfect source agreement after removing 2 anomalous field records; consistent +3 kWh/day linear ramp across all units
- Recommendations cover: anomaly root-cause investigation, naming convention standardization, pipeline automation, and reporting window expansion
